stage: Fixed after schema/codebook inspection, before any preference-model fit or allocation result
purpose: Test whether the existing finite-support diagnostic has consequences on a genuine repeated-task DCE with respondent-separated training and evaluation. This is an empirical scope audit within the same compensated menu objective, not a new estimator or a test of the Gaussian phase law.
population: Scottish consumer shortbread DCE, 299 released respondent records. Retain the 298 records with six complete menus; exclude the single two-menu record by completion only, with no choice-pattern or time exclusion.
allocation_method: For each allocation draw one permutation of the 138 correction-pool respondents. Budgets use nested prefixes and all six menus per selected respondent. Remaining pool respondents supply auxiliary menus with their outcomes hidden. Allocations reuse the same finite pool and holdout; they are not new people or independent population samples.
target_model: Eleven-parameter marginal conditional logit: option-1 and option-2 constants against neither; Bere ingredient indicator; medium/high nutrition indicators; quality-label indicator; speciality/grocery access indicators; elsewhere-Scotland/outside-Scotland origin indicators; linear cost per GBP10. Baseline levels follow the codebook. No synthetic noise columns or response-selected interactions.
predictor: Separate 33-parameter ridge conditional logit using the same 11 menu columns plus their interactions with centered ordinal age and education. Missing age/education are median-imputed using the 100 training respondents only. Scale age by (code-4)/3 and education by (code-3)/2. Freeze the fitted coefficients before any allocation. This is a fitted probability predictor, not AI-generated survey responses.
ridge_definition: Add 0.01 times squared Euclidean coefficient norm divided by two to mean menu loss, including constants. Fixed for teacher and all ridge baselines, without tuning on the holdout.
training_cost_control: all_human methods use the same 100 training respondents plus the labelled correction respondents. Report both incremental correction-label and total human-training costs; no free-training advantage is inferred.
cluster_power: At the common labelled-ridge pilot, use pooled design information and unbiased respondent-level covariance of six-task mean scores. Minimize trace of the usual sandwich quadratic over scalar power, clipped to [0,1]. This is the established cluster-aware control-variate criterion. Retain the raw value and clipping state. No confidence intervals or coverage claim.
pooling_definition: Mean loss over all 138 correction-pool respondents: observed labels on selected respondents, frozen predicted probabilities on the others. Its estimating target can differ from the compensated target.
support_check: Classical per-menu simplex moment support with strictly positive curvature-weight rank. Identical observed menu designs may be combined exactly by summing their weights. Interior, exterior, boundary/near-boundary, rank deficiency and unresolved solver statuses remain distinct. A finite optimizer vector does not establish attainment.
fit_check: For support-interior MLE/corrected fits, verify original-objective score max norm at most 1e-7 after Newton polishing. Retain failures separately. Ridge is positive definite by construction.
primary_outputs: Complete method-level support and fit counts
Heldout respondent-average human log loss and multicategory Brier loss on available fits
Paired heldout loss differences on common available allocations
All-allocation fallback risk using labelled ridge when corrected fit unavailable
uncertainty: Monte Carlo standard errors describe random allocation conditional on the fixed source, teacher and 60-person holdout. They do not quantify population or fresh-test uncertainty. Repeated budgets and methods share allocations.
verification: Independent original-row objective/gradient and metric reconstruction; all exterior rays checked against original menus; stratified separate residual LP checks; source, split and result hashes.
schema_correction_before_first_model_fit: The first preflight stopped before teacher fitting: 36 card numbers have 34 distinct attribute menus. Each card has exactly one design. Duplicate card pairs are combined by exact weights, with no responses discarded. This changes no budget, target, predictor or metric.
